title: Angular disagreement measure for large angles
statement: For $\pi/2\leq\alpha\leq\pi$, consider the angles $\theta\in(-\pi,\pi)$ for which $\cos\theta$ and $\cos(\theta-\alpha)$ have opposite signs. Their Lebesgue measure is $2\alpha$.
